description: This file defines the MemoryStreamProviderBuilder class, which implements provider building interfaces for Silo and Client builders in Orleans, configuring memory stream providers.

classes.name: MemoryStreamProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed class implementing provider builder interfaces for memory streams, configuring memory stream providers for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add memory streams with the specified name.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to add memory streams with the specified name.
